verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an AI customer-support platform, but the evidence pack documents no user-facing capability to select and act on many items at once. Watchtower, which reviews every interaction, and Ask AI, which analyzes conversations, are monitoring and analysis features rather than bulk actions, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
